verdict.rationale: Retell documents real-time transcription modes that trade latency against accuracy: interim results with low endpointing for speed, or context-aware results with higher endpointing for accuracy. That gives developers some control over transcription behavior. The evidence does not show choosing the STT provider, picking transcription language models, or adding key terms or keyword boosting. The language-model setting in basic configuration covers the agent's LLM, not speech-to-text. Missing for 10: STT provider selection, transcription language/model choice, key-term or vocabulary boosting, independent accuracy corroboration.
